name: M2 documents – classify by name with Ollama

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, stream: false, format: 'json', options: { temperature: 0 }, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'Classify documents of a fiduciary client file by folder and file name (German or English). Answer JSON {"items": [{"id", "value" (one of the allowed types), "confidence" 0..1}]}. Allowed: ' + $json.types.join(', ') }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify($json.unknown.map(u => ({ id: u.id, file: u.file }))) }] }) }}

parameters.content:
## M2 documents: type by name (local)
POST `{"files": ["AP-00031-ENT/KYC/passport.pdf", ...]}` to the webhook `m2-classify`. Keyword rules first, the rest goes to Ollama on this machine (never to the cloud: file names carry client names). Answers `{documents: [{file, type, confidence, by}]}`.
